Armed Conflict & Security
• A UN panel says at least 68 US strikes on suspected drug boats were not self-defense and could constitute crimes against humanity.
• Fighting on Yemen’s west coast has driven thousands across the Bab al-Mandab to Djibouti as the war escalates.
• Attempts at humanitarian truces in Sudan keep collapsing as rival factions prioritize battlefield gains.
• Infighting within the Sinaloa cartel has torn apart parts of Mexico since 2024, intensifying violence.
Why it matters: These conflicts and alleged violations highlight worsening humanitarian risks and legal scrutiny across multiple regions.

Geopolitics & Diplomacy

• Germany’s Chancellor Friedrich Merz called regional election losses a “disaster” but vowed to press ahead with reforms.
• Preliminary results in Russia’s parliamentary vote point to United Russia retaining its constitutional majority.
• Washington and Beijing hail progress ahead of a Trump‑Xi summit, including dialogue on AI risks and trade; Chinese rare earth exports to the US fell ahead of the meeting.
• President Trump urged Ukraine’s Zelenskyy to stop strikes on Russian refineries, emphasizing impacts on diesel supplies.
Why it matters: Outcomes from UNGA, European politics and US‑China talks could shape security, energy and tech policy.

Geopolitics & Diplomacy.text:
Helen Jenner will be party’s new head in Senedd as Farage says Dan Thomas’s arrest was a ‘bump in the road’Here are some more lines from Max Wilkinson’s speech to the Lib Dem conference this morning.Wilkinson, the Lib Dem home affairs spokesperson, accused Shabana Mahmood, the home secretary, of using “divisive language” that you would expect from the “authoritarian right”. After condemning the Tories and Reform UK for their anti-migration views, he said:And what’s the Labour response to this hard right agenda? Their home secretary has indulged in the sort of divisive language that we would usually expect from the authoritarian right …Well let me tell you home secretary – no matter how hard you chase, you’ll never catch up with [Nigel] Farage – that is a fool’s errand.He said that it was the duty of the Liberal Democrats to stand up to the Tories and Reform UK, and the “poison” they were spreading on migration. Repeatedly referring to Reform UK’s Robert Jenrick as a “plonker”, he said:[Jenrick] and his party are plonkers with dangerous ideas … and £72m to deliver them.And their allies in the Conservative party are weakly following them.He criticised the Conservatives and Reform UK for proposing to withdraw Britain from the European convention on human rights. He said:Leaving the European convention on human rights will not fix our asylum system.It will not stop dangerous Channel crossings – not a single boat – and it will not stop the criminal gangs.And he confirmed that the Lib Dems want to tax big tech to finance a new online crime agency. This was announced overnight and Peter Walker and Alexandra Topping have written the story up here.We will carry on as if nothing has happened
 We could have done without this bump in the road. But it has happened, We are making the best of it. Continue reading...

CDU suffered heavy losses in two regional elections, including in home state of former leader Angela Merkel, where it polled just 4.9%Staying in Germany, tens of thousands of automotive workers at Volkswagen, BMW, Mercedes-Benz and other car brands are protesting on factory floors across the country today for government and management help to save their jobs.
 Volkswagen has announced plans to cut 100,000 jobs in the next three years and BMW and Mercedes are also slashing their workforce.The problem is a near-existential one: the rise of Chinese EV carmakers with their cheaper, and in some cases more advanced models, has thrown the German car industry into crisis. The Germans, who have been far slower to transition to electric vehicles, simply aren’t selling as many cars anymore and need to retool to keep up.
 The fears are reflective of wider concerns over Europe’s industrial base being eroded by Chinese competition. Union leaders – pointing to state support for Chinese car makers- are calling for government support, like energy subsidies and financial help, or putting up trade protections. Continue reading...

Entertainment.title: LOEWE Perfumes Anchors Five New "Crafted" Fragrances to a Single Amber Accord
Entertainment.text: SummaryLOEWE Perfumes has released five new fragrances under its Crafted Collection, each built on the resinous amber base the house calls the LOEWE AccordHouse perfumer Nuria Cruelles composed the lineup, spanning open citrus, gourmand sweetness, dense florals and smoky depth across the five scentsEvery fragrance is presented in a flask topped with a tactile granite cap and finished in textures that run from glossy to powdery-dryLOEWE Perfumes has expanded its Crafted Collection with five new fragrances, each measuring 100mL and each anchored to the resinous amber base the house calls the LOEWE Accord. Composed by in-house perfumer Nuria Cruelles, the set layers familiar perfumery notes over that shared foundation to give every scent its own distinct character.Cruelles treats the amber LOEWE Accord as a common floor, then builds each fragrance upward with a different set of notes, so the five read as variations on a single idea rather than five unrelated launches."Field Diary" opens the range at its airiest, pairing mandarin and blood orange up top before lychee and orange blossom settle in, with artemisia cutting an aromatic contrast and sandalwood and musk trailing off into a soft finish. "Sweet Woodland" turns inward, resting on a base of patchouli and vanilla while rose, orange blossom, mandarin and ginger fill out the middle and a faint touch of cognac lends spicy warmth. "Rosetopia" is the most saturated of the five, centering on damask rose in full bloom and reinforcing it with amber, musk, grapefruit and pink pepper.The remaining two lean cooler and greener. "Smoky Rain" sends bergamot and pink pepper drifting through what LOEWE frames as a soft mist, then deepens the scent with a warm, smoky undertone alongside amber, patchouli and white musk. "Verdant Globe" starts on pistachio and bergamot, uses iris and orange blossom to hold the composition together, and widens into a gourmand stretch of caramel and vanilla before resolving on cedarwood and musk.The presentation is pitched to match the raw-material focus. Each bottle wears a granite cap meant to be felt as much as seen, while the flasks themselves are finished in a spread of textures, from high-gloss and matte to a damp sheen and a dry, powdery surface.Taken together, the launch reinforces the position LOEWE Perfumes has been building around single-ingredient legibility, where the point is to draw out and showcase each raw material rather than blur everything into one accordThe five Crafted fragrances are available now at select LOEWE Perfumes locations and through the brand's official online store.Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

Entertainment.title: Jhené Aiko Tops the Billboard 200 for the First Time With ‘Westside Whimsy’
Entertainment.text: SummaryJhené Aiko earns her first Billboard 200 No. 1 as Westside Whimsy debuts atop the chart dated September 26The album opens with 74,000 equivalent album units, almost entirely on the strength of streamingIt stands as the first R&B album by a woman to lead the chart in 2026Jhené Aiko's Westside Whimsy debuts at No. 1 on the Billboard 200, handing the singer-songwriter the first chart-topping album of her career. The set arrives on the September 26-dated chart with 74,000 equivalent album units earned in the United States in the tracking week ending September 17, according to Luminate.Streaming carried the debut almost single-handedly. Of that 74,000 total, streaming equivalent albums accounted for 70,000, a figure powered by 71.33 million on-demand official streams that also sent the project to No. 1 on Top Streaming Albums. Pure sales told a quieter story: with the album available only as a digital purchase ahead of physical editions slated for January, it moved 3,500 copies to open at No. 25 on Top Album Sales, while track-equivalent albums added another 500 units.The milestone lands more than a decade in the making. Westside Whimsy is Aiko's first full-length studio album since 2020's Chilombo, which debuted and peaked at No. 2 before earning an album of the year nomination at the Grammys. Her latest becomes her sixth top 10 on the Billboard 200, a run that traces back to Sail Out, the 2013 entry that first reached No. 8. The gap between that debut and this leader spanned 12 years and 10 months, making Aiko the second act of 2026 to wait at least a decade for a first No. 1, after Megadeth closed a nearly 40-year gap earlier this year. Among women, the last to wait longer was Solange, whose A Seat at the Table topped the chart 13 years and eight months after her own chart debut.The No. 1 also reshapes the year's R&B picture. Westside Whimsy is the genre's first chart-topper from a woman in 2026 and the first R&B album to lead since SZA's SOS logged its 13th and final week on top in May 2025. The only other R&B set to reach the summit this year was Bruno Mars' The Romantic.Behind Aiko, the rest of the top 10 stayed still, with her album the only new arrival in the region. Ella Langley's Dandelion slips to No. 2 on a little over 60,000 units, trailed by Olivia Rodrigo's you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love at No. 3 (60,000) and Morgan Wallen's I'm the Problem at No. 4 (57,000). Noah Kahan's The Great Divide holds at No. 5 (46,000), while Drake's ICEMAN climbs 9-6 (35,000). Ariana Grande's petal eases to No. 7 (34,000), Rod Wave's Don't Look Down dips 7-8 (nearly 34,000), Olivia Dean's The Art of Loving rises 10-9 (33,000) and Kahan's Stick Season rounds out the tier, moving 13-10 (nearly 33,000).Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

Economy & Markets.title: The 2027 Cadillac Escalade Starts at $105,595 USD as the Flagship SUV Crosses the Six-Figure Mark
Economy & Markets.text: SummaryCadillac has launched the online configurator for the 2027 EscaladeThe elimination of the base 1SA trim pushes starting prices above six figuresThe top-tier Escalade V ESV approaches the $200,000 mark before optionsCadillac launched the online configurator for the 2027 Cadillac Escalade recently. This iteration of the SUV arrives with a heavier financial barrier to entry. The automaker eliminated the 1SA base trim level offered during the previous model year. Because the discontinued specification targeted livery services rather than retail buyers, its removal reshapes the bottom of the lineup. Removing the 1SA base model officially raises the starting price above $100,000 USD. A standard-length rear-wheel drive model starts at $105,595 USD. Entry pricing represents an $11,600 increase over the 2026 entry price. The six-figure floor includes a destination charge that remains unchanged from last year.At the absolute pinnacle of the lineup sits the 2027 Escalade V ESV trim. It commands $193,349 USD before any additional options are considered. This price includes a $2,895 USD destination charge. By approaching the $200,000 USD threshold, the American automaker leans into the vehicle's long-standing cultural cachet. The model has served as a flagship for two decades. Pushing pricing into the elite realm targets territory traditionally occupied by exotic luxury flagships.Owners spending these amounts step into an SUV that remains largely identical to its predecessor since Cadillac announced no substantial changes for the 2027 model year. The current generation originally entered the market for the 2021 model year. Recent architecture updates for the 2025 model year refreshed the platform against rivals. This previous overhaul provided enough momentum that the brand kept the hardware static while raising the financial stakes.Economic factors loom while the Cadillac nameplate dictates immense pricing power. Rising gas prices alter the landscape for massive high-displacement vehicles. Such friction transforms the pricing strategy into a significant gamble for the manufacturer. This trend questions whether decades of flagship dominance can outrun the realities of a shifting global economy. Science & Technology.title: Tesla Reopens Roadster Reservations for $50,000 USD Ahead of an October 1 Reveal
Science & Technology.text: SummaryTesla has reopened orders for its next-generation Roadster, requiring a massive $50,000 USD deposit weeks before the vehicle's official unveilingThe October 1 event in Texas is set to feature a hovering, remote-operated stunt car equipped with SpaceX cold gas thrustersThe fresh round of reservations arrives despite the original 2017 Roadster suffering at least eight delays without delivering a single production unitThe Tesla Roadster is officially back on the order books, and securing a spot in line requires a massive injection of blind faith. During the week of September 20, the automaker quietly reopened reservations for its next-generation electric hypercar, asking buyers to commit heavy funds before a final production version has even been shown. Claiming a reservation requires a steep $50,000 USD deposit initiated by a fully refundable $5,000 USD credit card payment and locked in by a $45,000 USD wire transfer that must be completed within 10 days. The reservation portal went live approximately two weeks ahead of a highly anticipated October 1 reveal event scheduled near Waco, Texas, where the company states it will finally outline official pricing, hardware specifications and production targets.By demanding an immediate five-figure commitment for an unseen silhouette, the automaker tests the limits of its own brand loyalty against a notoriously fractured track record. This marks the second time the company has collected $50,000 USD deposits for the Tesla Roadster following a November 2017 push that also offered a $250,000 USD Founders Series option requiring total payment upfront. That original 2017 iteration was promised for production in 2020 but has since suffered at least eight separate delays without putting a single unit on the road in nearly nine years. Making matters more complex for early adopters, the company has previously made it difficult for high-profile reservation holders, including tech creator Marques Brownlee and OpenAI executive Sam Altman, to successfully receive refunds on canceled preorders.The upcoming October 1 showcase aims to reset the narrative by swapping outdated concepts for a stark aesthetic overhaul. Recent teasers indicate the new iteration will abandon older curves for a sharp redesign that heavily incorporates angular Cyber styling complete with a modern full-width light bar. This updated aesthetic attempts to eclipse the massive promises made back in 2017 when the vehicle was pitched with a $200,000 base price, a 620-mile battery range, a top speed pushing past 250 mph and a scorching 0-60 mph time of under 1.9 seconds.To sell the radically updated vision, CEO Elon Musk has teased an extravagant live demonstration for the Tesla Roadster built around SpaceX designed cold gas thrusters that he claims will allow the car to physically hover or fly. However, this thruster-equipped stunt car is expected to be entirely remote-operated, will not be street legal and could command a standalone price tag in the hundreds of thousands of dollars on its own. Musk explicitly stated at the All-In Summit that a live audience is required for the Texas event so attendees can personally vouch that the physics-defying demonstration is not generated by AI. Despite the theatrical push, the broader market remains skeptical of an imminent launch. Art & Culture.title: ARCHIVIO J.M.Ribot Brings Its Immersive Installation to Dover Street Market Beijing
Art & Culture.text: ARCHIVIO J.M.Ribot’s immersive special installation, A Body Without a Body, has recently arrived at Dover Street Market Beijing in Wangfujing Central, accompanied by the brand’s 21st capsule collection and 10th-anniversary capsule, “The Hollow Carnival.”Founded by designer Karim Fares, ARCHIVIO J.M.Ribot is rooted in his long-standing archive of antique textiles, vintage clothing, and old objects. Rejecting the fleeting narratives of trend cycles, the brand remains committed to slow, locally made Italian craftsmanship, preserving rather than erasing the traces of time inherent in its materials. Faded textures, mending stitches, and worn imperfections become inseparable parts of each piece. Drawing on the colorful remnants left after a carnival has ended, “The Hollow Carnival” serves as a metaphor for contemporary society: people continually pursue instant consumption and sensory pleasure, while beneath the appearance of abundance lies a sense of emptiness and melancholy. This is the conceptual core of the 21st collection.The installation makes use of the site’s architectural structure and the flow of visitors, with the building itself forming part of the work. The exhibition space is enclosed by antique screens, while layered scraps of aged wallpaper cover the screens and the venue’s columns, evoking geological strata built up from accumulated memories. At its center, an antique sofa displays timeworn vintage teddy bears marked by repairs, accompanied by arrangements of dried flowers and ribbons. Together, they hold a collective memory in which childhood, emotion, and time intertwine. The central work, “A Body Without a Body,” is composed of layers of clothing piled one atop another. Beneath torn, weathered fabrics, layers of old garments gradually emerge. Each textile layer is a sediment of memory: though the body has vanished, the wear and mending preserved in the fabric recall the traces of human presence.The exhibition also presents ARCHIVIO J.M.Ribot’s two principal creative threads: a limited collection newly made from antique fabrics, and the one-of-a-kind Riforma collection, created by reworking vintage garments. Every piece is handmade in Italy. Industrial overlocking is eschewed in favor of interior details such as hand-worked buttonholes and irregular stitching, inviting visitors to linger over the stories held within the materials.Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast
